{{Quote|Imperial Knights! Save your Emperor!|Mohrgan Fel's command to the brown-haired Imperial Knight and two others|<ref name="Legacy 1" />}}
A '''Human''' with [[Color/Legends|brown]] hair and a goatee was an [[Imperial Knight]] serving [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] of the [[Fel Empire|Galactic Empire]] in [[130 ABY]]. Shortly after Fel's forces defeated the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] at the [[Battle of Caamas]] and won the [[Sith–Imperial War]], Fel was betrayed by his [[One Sith|Sith]] allies. However, he received advanced knowledge of the betrayal and fled into [[Empire-in-exile|exile]]. To cover his escape, he sent four Imperial Knights, including the brown-haired individual, against the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]]. Krayt arrived at the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|New Imperial Palace]] on the Imperial [[Planet/Legends|throneworld]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Attack on Emperor Fel|slew]] all four Knights, proclaiming himself the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of a [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|new Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|They'll expect me&mdash;and a contingent of Imperial Knights&mdash;to appear at the council&hellip;''"<br />"''I'll lead them&mdash;and your double.|Roan and Mohrgan Fel|<ref name="Legacy 8" />}}
[[File:ImperialKnightsSlain-SWLEG01.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The brown-haired individual and three other Imperial Knights are slain by Darth Krayt.]]
A [[Color/Legends|brown]]-haired [[Human/Legends|Human]] with a goatee was a member of the [[Imperial Knight]]s in [[130 ABY]].<ref name="Legacy 8" /> The Imperial Knights were a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-using]] order that had pledged loyalty to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] of the [[Fel Empire|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the brown-haired Imperial Knight was involved in a deception orchestrated by Fel against the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]]. Following [[Battle of Caamas|the conclusion]] of the [[Sith–Imperial War]], Fel was informed by [[Morrigan Corde|Nyna Calixte]], the [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]], that his [[One Sith|Sith]] allies who had helped his Empire win the war against the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] were planning to betray him. [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Krayt intended to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Fel and seize the Imperial throne at an upcoming meeting of the Imperial [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Council of Moffs]]. Fel fled from the Imperial [[Planet/Legends|throneworld]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], but felt that it was necessary for [[Roan Fel's double|his double]] to meet with Krayt in the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|New Imperial Palace]] in order to buy him [[Time/Legends|time]] to escape.<ref name="Legacy 8" />

Fel's cousin, the Imperial Knight [[Mohrgan Fel]], volunteered to lead three other Knights against Krayt in order to further the deception. Mohrgan, the brown-haired Knight, and [[Unidentified Imperial Knight 1|two]] [[Unidentified Imperial Knight 2|others]] stood by the decoy [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]<ref name="Legacy 8" /> as he and the [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] discussed the end of the war and its consequences. When Krayt arrived with [[Darth Maladi|three]] [[Darth Nihl|of]] [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|his]] fellow [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]], he demanded Fel's life. Mohrgan called on his contingent to protect the Emperor, but Krayt drew [[Jar'Kai/Legends|two]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and [[Attack on Emperor Fel|struck]] them all down, [[Cho sun/Legends|severing]] the brown-haired Knight's weapon [[Limb/Legends|arm]] before taking his life. He then slew the decoy Emperor and proclaimed himself Emperor of a [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|new Empire]]. Fel and the remaining Imperial Knights were forced into [[Empire-in-exile|exile]].<ref name="Legacy 1" /><ref name="Legacy 8" />

==Powers and abilities==
The brown-haired individual was a member of the Imperial Knights,<ref name="Legacy 1" /><ref name="Legacy 8" /> an organization whose membership was limited to those who displayed potential in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The Imperial Knights were said to be among the most talented and dangerous Force-users in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="LECG" /> Although Roan Fel kept the Imperial Knights from participating in the Sith&ndash;Imperial War,<ref name="Legacy 8" /> the brown-haired Imperial Knight fought against Darth Krayt after the war's end, where he and three of his brethren were quickly struck down by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] dual lightsabers.<ref name="Legacy 1" /><ref name="Legacy 8" />

==Behind the scenes==
The brown-haired Imperial Knight was introduced in [[Legacy (2006) 1|the first issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'', written by [[John Ostrander]], penciled by [[Jan Duursema]], and released in [[June]] [[2006]].<ref name="Legacy 1" /> The events of that issue were retold in ''Legacy''{{'s}} [[Legacy (2006) 8|eighth issue]], released in [[February]] [[2007]], wherein three of the Knights remained unidentified and one was dubbed Mohrgan.<ref name="Legacy 8" />
